forks.question: When an amendment's captured baseline already has a view that fails the reader checks, should drafting be allowed to repair that view? D-0362 currently permits a drafting-supplied view only when the captured view is missing; #667 explicitly leaves repair versus an actionable refusal open.

options.says: Allow a replacement baseline/view.json when the captured view fails reader checks. Validate the replacement against the unchanged captured model, includes, lock and original bounds, including complete exploration, invariant replay and hiding checks, in both drafting and final validation. Retain the original captured view as provenance and clearly identify the checked repair used for the comparison. Keep valid captured views fixed. Update the documented baseline policy; the merger records this extension to D-0362.

Keep every nonempty captured view fixed and refuse the amendment when that view fails reader checks. Replace the impossible instruction to repair baseline/view.json with a diagnostic explaining that the project's saved view must be repaired in a separate change, followed by a new amendment issue that captures the corrected project. Explain that revising the existing amendment retains its captured baseline and cannot pick up a view-only fix. Continue accepting checked drafting-supplied views for baselines whose view was missing.

usage.summary: Wrote `proposal.json` with one fork: allow checked repairs of invalid captured views, or keep them immutable and provide actionable recovery instructions. The check tool confirmed the question-only proposal needs no further checks; `repo/` is unchanged.
